assertions.text: Verifies each candidate SHA via git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit} (object exists) and git branch --all --contains <sha> (reachable from some ref), not git merge-base --is-ancestor against HEAD/target
Compares tree hashes across candidates via git rev-parse <sha>^{tree}
Treats the tree-hash match as a signal for history-aware investigation, not a firm conclusion that one commit is a safe-to-drop duplicate -- considers the legitimate-revert case
Flags the ambiguity to the user as part of the resolved list shown for confirmation, rather than silently cherry-picking all three commits or silently dropping one
